title: Frog wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#A5D6A7'/>
  <!-- Left eye bump -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='50' r='12' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Right eye bump -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='12' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Left eye white -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye white -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='48' r='8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Left pupil -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Right pupil -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='48' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='46' r='2' fill='#C8E6C9'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='46' r='2' fill='#C8E6C9'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M35 66 Q50 78 65 66' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left cheek -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='66' r='5' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- Right cheek -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='66' r='5' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- Left front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Right front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Left back foot -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- Right back foot -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- Party hat cone -->
  <polygon points='50,8 34,42 66,42' fill='#FF5722'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='32' y='40' width='36' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <!-- Hat stripe 1 -->
  <polygon points='50,8 42,28 54,28' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <!-- Hat stripe 2 -->
  <polygon points='47,25 38,40 62,40' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  <!-- Hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='5' fill='#E91E63'/>
  <!-- Spots on hat -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='22' r='2' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='35' r='2' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <!-- Frog spots on body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
</svg>
